in_marathi.name: Chandramadhav
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon God's treasure
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandramadhav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandra (Moon) - Mada (god) - Dhava (treasure) Chandramadhav is the name of Lord Vishnu, who holds the moon in his hand as a symbol of his power over the cycles of time.
